) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Process and filter data based on specified criteria.
    
    Args:
        data: List of dictionaries containing the data to process
        filter_key: Key to use for filtering
        threshold: Optional threshold value for filtering
        
    Returns:
        Filtered list of dictionaries
        
    Raises:
        ValueError: If filter_key is not found in data
        TypeError: If data is not in expected format
        
    Example:
        >>> data = [{"score": 85, "name": "Alice"}, {"score": 92, "name": "Bob"}]
        >>> process_data(data, "score", 90)
        [{"score": 92, "name": "Bob"}]
